observations.body: So I caused them to go out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Ezekiel retells departure from Egypt, wilderness statutes, rebellion, and judgment.
observations.label: A long retelling of rebellion

observations.body: Statutes, Sabbaths, restraint, judgment, and rebellion repeat across Ezekiel’s wilderness account.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Ezekiel 20:8–25 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: God acts for his name while still exposing the people’s refusal.
payload.title: Brought out, brought into
